data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best all-round password manager.

However, **Bitwarden Teams** is a very strong alternative if keeping costs down is more important.

The key is to choose something that makes it easy to\:

- Share passwords securely without sending them over email or Slack.
- Give each employee their own account.
- Control who can access particular passwords and shared vaults.
- Remove access immediately when someone leaves.
- Enforce two-factor authentication (2FA).
- Manage company logins separately from personal passwords.

## Best options compared

**1\. 1Password Business** (Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions.
- Very user-friendly for non-technical staff.
- Strong administration and security reporting.
- Business plan: approximately \$8.99/user/month.
  
  [Official website and pricing](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams** (Best value)

- Open-source password manager.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Good security and audit capabilities.
- Approximately \$4/user/month.
  
  [Official website and pricing](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Business**

- Strong administrative controls.
- Good for compliance-conscious businesses.
- Detailed permissions and reporting.
- Business Starter approximately \$2/user/month.
  
  [Official website and pricing](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass for Business**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Shared vaults and secure sharing.
- Particularly interesting if you already use Proton services.
  
  [Official website and pricing](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Indicative USD prices, generally based on annual billing. Check current UK pricing, VAT and plan limits before purchasing. ## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to Bitwarden and 1Password\:

| Consideration | Winner |
|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | 1Password |
| Value for money | Bitwarden |
| Team sharing | Both |
| Admin controls | 1Password |
| Open-source transparency | Bitwarden |
